description: This file defines the PieDataLabelRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering data labels on pie charts within the PDFsharp charting library. It includes methods for formatting label content, drawing labels, and calculating label positions specific to pie charts.

classes.name: PieDataLabelRenderer
classes.description: A class that handles rendering data labels for pie charts in the PDFsharp charting system.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space used by the data labels based on their type (percentage or value) and formats the label text accordingly.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the data labels onto the pie chart using the graphics context.

methods.name: CalcPositions
methods.description: Calculates the positions of the data labels for pie chart sectors, based on their start angle and sweep angle, and their specified label position.
